solarPanel.reference: Trina Solar Vertex S+ TSM-450NEG9R.28, TSM_EN_2024_A_S1
solarPanel.facts: STC 450 W, Voc 52.9 V, Isc 10.74 A, Vmpp 44.6 V, Impp 10.09 A. Voc −0.24%/K, Isc +0.04%/K; area 1762 × 1134 mm. Published NOCT point: 344 W at 800 W/m², nominal cell temperature 43°C.
solarPanel.assumptions: Series resistance and diode ideality voltage fitted to STC points and stationary MPP; infinite shunt resistance. Temperature scaling uses Voc and Isc coefficients, not an independently forced power coefficient. Shading is uniform irradiance reduction; bypass diodes, mismatch and local maxima are omitted. Cell temperature is prescribed by an external reservoir. Unconverted sunlight leaves that reservoir; no thermal panel dynamics.

lfpBattery.facts: 100 Ah, 4/8 cells, 1280/2560 Wh nominal; 0.8/1.6 mΩ. Maximum charge/discharge 200 A; recommended charge ≤50 A, discharge ≤100 A. Charge +5…50°C, discharge −20…50°C; end of discharge 11.2/22.4 V; recommended absorption 14.2/28.4 V and float 13.5/27 V.
lfpBattery.assumptions: The reference pack REQUIRES an external BMS. This generic component bundles a simplified directional BMS and configurable overcurrent isolation, with immediate thermal recovery. SOC curve is a typical rested LFP open-circuit table (2.5–3.40 V per cell, 13.6 V full for 4 cells), not a measured manufacturer curve; the 3.65 V per cell charge cut-off is a terminal voltage under charge, not an OCV. Coulombic efficiency 99.5%, lumped heat capacity and UA are assumed. Published 92% round-trip efficiency is not forced; actual efficiency depends on current, voltage and losses. Cold capacity derating, cell imbalance, ageing and hysteresis omitted.

mpptController.facts: 100 V maximum PV Voc, 20 A PV short-circuit/output current limits; nominal 290 W at 12 V / 580 W at 24 V; peak efficiency 98%; startup PV > battery +5 V, running +1 V. Full output to 40°C, operating to 60°C.
mpptController.assumptions: Educational perturb-and-observe voltage tracker, not proprietary firmware; 0.25 V perturbations every 0.2 s. Constant 98% converter efficiency; no standby consumption or gradual thermal derating. Absorption duration 1800 s assumed. Profiles use battery-recommended LFP voltages. Galvanically separate averaged ports; reference hardware is common-negative. No equalization or integrated load output.

inverter.facts: 500 VA / 400 W continuous at 25°C; 350 W at 40°C; 900 W peak; 230 V, 50/60 Hz; 90% peak efficiency, 6.5 W idle, 1.5 W ECO; low shutdown/restart 18.6/21.8 V, upper input 34 V.
inverter.assumptions: Ideal sinusoidal RMS output; switching, harmonics, DC ripple and inverter startup inrush omitted. Nonnegative idle + load-proportional + quadratic apparent-load loss, calibrated so efficiency never exceeds the configured maximum. Peak load is half rated power when feasible (assumed); otherwise it is derived from idle power and maximum efficiency. Two-second surge duration assumed, not published. Overload latches until reset. Explicit standby disables output; automatic ECO polling and temperature derating omitted.

batteryProtection.reference: Victron Smart BatteryProtect 12/24 V 65 A (behavior reference)
batteryProtection.facts: Independent downstream load protection; distinct from battery cell BMS. Reference family includes a 65 A continuous variant and configurable low voltage programs.
batteryProtection.assumptions: Immediate 11.8 V disconnect / 12.8 V recovery, 2 mΩ on resistance, thermal capacity/UA and 65°C cutoff are educational choices. Overcurrent latches until reset. Remote enable is a logical signal. Bidirectional ideal contact; reference hardware is unidirectional and must not directly switch inverter input. Use inverter remote control in a real installation. Quiescent power, delays and reverse-current protections omitted.
